title: Rheumatoid Arthritis
definition: RA's symmetric small-joint inflammation is now controllable — early DMARDs plus biologics induce remission undreamed of decades ago. Treat-to-target guides. Joints, preserved.
patient_flow: Referrals come for joint pain, positive ANAs, or mysterious inflammation; workup blends history, exam, labs, and imaging over visits. Treatment steps from NSAIDs to DMARDs to biologics with tight monitoring. Infusion suites deliver biologics regularly; clinics track disease activity scores lifelong, adjusting to keep inflammation in remission.
code_demo:
def das28(tender28, swollen28, esr, patient_global):
    """DAS28 rheumatoid arthritis activity estimator (simplified)."""
    import math
    d = 0.56*math.sqrt(tender28) + 0.28*math.sqrt(swollen28) + 0.70*math.log(esr) + 0.014*patient_global
    band = "remission" if d < 2.6 else "low" if d < 3.2 else "moderate" if d <= 5.1 else "high"
    return f"DAS28 {d:.2f} -> {band} disease activity"
print(das28(6, 4, 28, 40))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
